description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Eos' task in a GStreamer-based media player, testing end-of-stream behavior for different media types and underflow conditions.

classes.name: EosTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing the Eos task in the media player.

methods.name: shouldFailWhenStreamIsNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the stream info is not present in the context.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Tests successful setting of end-of-stream for an audio stream.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when gstAppSrcEndOfStream returns an error.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndCancelAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for audio stream and cancelling audio underflow.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndSkipCancellingVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for audio stream when video underflow occurred, skipping video underflow cancellation.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndCancelVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for video stream and cancelling video underflow.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndSkipCancellingAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Tests setting EOS for video stream when audio underflow occurred, skipping audio underflow cancellation.
